derivedFlags.staleRuleHit: ruleEvaluation.matchedRuleIds includes 'stale-data-detection' OR cards[].ruleId == 'stale-data-detection' OR cards[].id == 'rec-data-stale-01'

zh.title: 未达非降级可运行
zh.oneLiner: 当前仍有链路或数据质量阻塞，暂不满足签收条件。
zh.nextAction: 先修复上游/缺失指标并连续复测两次（间隔>=5分钟）。

en.title: Not Ready for Non-Degraded Run
en.oneLiner: Blocking issues still exist in source connectivity or data quality, so signoff is not allowed yet.
en.nextAction: Fix upstream/missing metrics and pass two consecutive checks (>=5 min apart).

vi.title: Chua dat dieu kien van hanh phi suy giam
vi.oneLiner: Van con diem nghen ve ket noi nguon hoac chat luong du lieu, chua du dieu kien ky nhan.
vi.nextAction: Sua nguon/thieu chi so va dat 2 lan kiem tra lien tiep (cach nhau >=5 phut).

en.title: Not Ready
en.oneLiner: Pipeline or data is still blocked

vi.title: Chua san sang
vi.oneLiner: Du lieu hoac ket noi van bi nghen
vi.nextAction: Sua truoc, dat 2 lan lien tiep

zh.title: 可运行（有风险提示）
zh.oneLiner: 系统主链路可用，但仍有规则可评估性风险，建议按边界执行。
zh.nextAction: 先消除 skipped/COP 缺失，再恢复高风险调参节奏。

en.title: Runnable with Risk Notice
en.oneLiner: Core pipeline is available, but rule evaluability risks remain and require bounded operations.
en.nextAction: Clear skipped/COP-missing conditions before resuming high-risk tuning pace.

vi.title: Co the van hanh (con canh bao rui ro)
vi.oneLiner: Chuoi du lieu chinh da san sang, nhung van con rui ro ve kha nang danh gia rule.
vi.nextAction: Xu ly xong skipped/thieu COP truoc khi tro lai nhip dieu chinh rui ro cao.

zh.title: 可运行但有风险
zh.oneLiner: 主链路可用，评估有风险

en.title: Runnable with Risk
en.oneLiner: Core path is up, evaluability risk remains

vi.title: Van hanh co rui ro
vi.oneLiner: Chuoi chinh san sang, van co rui ro danh gia
vi.nextAction: Xu ly skipped va COP thieu truoc

zh.title: 系统已达非降级可运行
zh.oneLiner: 当前签收门槛已通过，可按非降级态口径稳定运行。
zh.nextAction: 冻结版本点并按常规巡检节奏持续监控。

en.title: System Reached Non-Degraded Runnable State
en.oneLiner: Signoff gates are passed and the system can run under non-degraded criteria.
en.nextAction: Freeze baseline and continue standard monitoring cadence.

vi.title: He thong da dat trang thai van hanh phi suy giam
vi.oneLiner: Cac cong ky nhan da dat, he thong co the van hanh on dinh theo tieu chi phi suy giam.
vi.nextAction: Dong bang moc phien ban va duy tri giam sat theo lich thuong le.

zh.title: 已达非降级运行
zh.oneLiner: 签收门槛通过，可稳定运行

en.title: Non-Degraded Ready
en.oneLiner: Signoff gates passed, stable to run
en.nextAction: Freeze baseline and keep routine checks

vi.title: Dat phi suy giam
vi.oneLiner: Da qua cong ky nhan, van hanh on dinh
vi.nextAction: Dong bang baseline va giam sat dinh ky

zeroValueButPresent.purpose: Explain zero value as valid reading when source is healthy, to avoid false 'missing' interpretation.

zh.title: 值为0但数据有效
zh.oneLiner: 0 表示当前读数，不等于字段缺失。
zh.nextAction: 先确认 sourceStatus=ok，再结合趋势判断。

en.title: Zero Value, Data Present
en.oneLiner: A value of 0 is a valid reading, not a missing field.
en.nextAction: Confirm sourceStatus=ok, then judge with trend context.

vi.title: Gia tri 0 nhung du lieu hop le
vi.oneLiner: Gia tri 0 la so do hop le, khong phai thieu truong.
vi.nextAction: Xac nhan sourceStatus=ok, sau do danh gia theo xu huong.
